scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:workspace && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:markdown
scripts.lint:workspace: pnpm --filter @alexandria/ax run lint && pnpm --filter @alexandria/viewer run check
scripts.lint:shell: shellcheck -x install.sh setup scripts/ensure-shell-tools scripts/setup-dev scripts/setup-worktree
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:prettier && pnpm run format:check:shell
scripts.format:check:prettier: pnpm --filter @alexandria/library-card-resolver run format:check && pnpm --filter @alexandria/ax run format:check && pnpm --filter @alexandria/viewer run format:check
scripts.format:check:shell: shfmt -d install.sh setup scripts/ensure-shell-tools scripts/setup-dev scripts/setup-worktree
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @alexandria/library-card-resolver run typecheck && pnpm --filter @alexandria/ax run typecheck
